summary: Set rust-version to 1.63 and removed the let-else; pinned fieldsplit 0.4.1 (0.4.3 needs 1.70) and updated checkchar to 1.3.0 (using mod37_2_iso to keep '*'), then re-vendored through the mirror. Fixed crate features and the version inheritance, registered the formats test, fixed the no-json build, added rerun-if-changed for the site table, and added path remapping to the Makefile. make test, the core-only and no-default-features builds, and byte-identical builds in two directories all check out.
